CustomField.description: Formula that converts the relative path in Form Banner Image into a fully-qualified, renderable image URL. It prefixes '/sfsites/c' for Experience Cloud/CDN contexts, otherwise derives the org base URL from $Api.Enterprise_Server_URL_100; returns blank when Form Banner Image is empty. Read-only — there is nothing to enter. Use this field (not the raw path field) anywhere an absolute banner URL is needed for display.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This read-only field automatically builds the full image URL from the Form Banner Image path, so you never edit it directly. It returns blank when no banner image is set; reference this field rather than the raw path whenever you need a displayable URL.
CustomField.label: Form Banner Image URL
